verses.english: The Interior as Suffering in the Three Times

verses.pali: “Cakkhu, bhikkhave, dukkhaṁ atītaṁ anāgataṁ paccuppannaṁ …pe… jivhā dukkhā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā …pe… mano dukkho atīto anāgato paccuppanno.
verses.english: “Mendicants, in the past … future … present the eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind are suffering …”
